product: xAI Grok 4.6 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
tagline: Model Serving now supports xAI Grok 4.6 as a Databricks hosted model.
what_it_does: Model Serving now supports xAI Grok 4.6 as a Databricks hosted model. This reasoning model has a 500,000 token context window and supports configurable reasoning effort and function calling for coding, agentic workflows, and other complex tasks. You can access this model using Foundation Model APIs.
why_it_matters: Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with applicable terms.
